title: Code Interpreter Test Harness
description:
Implement test harness suites from docs/plans/07-code-interpreter-test-harness.md.

Sections: All sections (§1-§10)

Key deliverables:
- Property tests P1-P8: deterministic execution, step budget, conversion round-trip, sandbox closure, backend neutrality, RLM token budget monotonicity, DataStore key isolation, tier classification consistency
- Fault injection F1-F8: tool error storms, timeout races, oversized trace/result, VM interrupt chaos, concurrent scripts, RLM provider failures, DataStore failures, budget exhaustion races
- Comparison/oracle O1-O5: golden trace corpus, capability oracle, tool-call parity, DataStore implementation oracle, RLM cost oracle
- Deterministic simulations S1-S6: progressive discovery, limit boundary, failure recovery, RLM map-reduce, tier escalation, DataStore lifecycle
- Benchmarks B1-B6: startup <5ms/<20ms, builtin <200us, trace <1ms/<5ms, cache >=30%, RLM <500us, DataStore >=1M ops/sec
- Stress/soak ST1-ST5: 12h script churn, 500 concurrent scripts, adversarial loops, DataStore capacity, RLM burst
- Security SEC1-SEC7: sandbox breakout, import denial, resource exhaustion, sensitive data, RLM prompt injection, DataStore path traversal, cross-session isolation
- CI tier matrix with Makefile targets

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/07-code-interpreter.md
- Test harness: docs/plans/07-code-interpreter-test-harness.md §1-§10
- Depends on: T7 (Starlark Runtime) + T8 (RLM + DataStore)
